title: Maple's Pig Collection
description: Seasonal pig variants with custom textures that change with the seasons! 🐷
body:
✨Make Your Minecraft World Pig-ture Perfect 🐷

Custom designed pig textures to bring a little something extra to your gameplay.

The textures change automatically with the seasons! (can be turned off)

🌱 The Sapling mod needs to be installed in order for this mod to work 🌱

⚙️This mod needs to be installed on both the client and the server so you can see the same textures as your friends 🤗 

The pig variations spawn randomly across the world. 

The pigs stay in their own skin when re-opening a world, collect 'm all! 🤗

🌸☀️🍂❄️

The textures will automatically change per season. There will also still be regular pigs.

 

The season dates: day - month

🌸Spring:  01-03 / 31-05         ☀️Summer: 01-06 / 31-08 
🍂Autumn:  01-09 / 30-11          ❄️Winter:  01-12 / 28-02          

 

There is also an added command for which hemisphere you prefer! Northern or Southern 😊
(Northern is selected automatically)


‼️🏷️If you want to keep a certain pig texture on a specific pig for the whole year make sure to give

them a name tag before the new season starts! Otherwise, they will change. ‼️🏷️

 

Commands
⚙️To customize your experience.

 

Admin Tools
/maplemods pig adminTools flipSeasonDatesToOtherHemisphere   | To change the hemisphere
/maplemods pig adminTools resetAllLoadedEntityTextures   |  To reset the pigs that are already loaded in the game
/maplemods pig adminTools reloadConfigFile  | To reload changes in the Config

 

Config Values
/maplemods pig setConfigValues showCurrentValues
/maplemods pig setConfigValues disableSeasonsDuringHoliday (false/true)  | Option to disable the mixture of the holidays and the seasonal textures.
/maplemods pig setConfigValues nameTagPreventsTexture (false/true)  | Option to save the texture with the name tag or to disable it.
/maplemods pig setConfigValues replaceSeasonalTextures  | To reload the textures after making a change.

 

Update Category Settings
/maplemods pig updateCategorySettings _default   | Disable or enable the original pig texture
/maplemods pig updateCategorySettings <category> (disable/enable/setDate)  | Customize the seasons

 

Update Texture Settings
/maplemods pig updateTextureSettings <texture> (disable/enable) | To specifically choose which textures to enable or disable

 

 

Very excited to finally design and launch my custom pigs!

✨ Hope you enjoy seeing them oink around as much as I enjoyed creating them ✨
